preparation_basis: GPU encoder pass for the Thinking speech packets of the 266-E read (re-registration of 2026-10-11; owner ruling: the CPU sidecar at 16-19 s per row is unacceptable). Geometry mirrors configs/model/q4km-e21-feature-preprocess-gpu-cddb000c-np1.json (-np 1 -ngl 999 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -b 512 -ub 128, GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1) with the context the Instruct Fold B pass used (-c 16384); the Thinking decoder AND its own bf16 mmproj are both offloaded (no --no-mmproj-offload). The card holds one core: every serving session must be stopped before this server starts and the Thinking serving session starts after it; the chain is scripts/flights/direct/direct_fb_packets_gpu.sh inside a serving-swap window. Own packet root and legacy cache: GPU- and CPU-made encoder outputs are not bit-identical. Offline packet preparation only: one-token responses are discarded unread, no answer is scored.
